paragraphs.text: Deathfed is a green / blue / black event deck with a " graveyard matters" theme.
The rares in this deck are Hinterland Harbor , Birds of Paradise , Splinterfright , Bonehoard , Bonehoard , Ratchet Bomb , and Green Sun's Zenith .
Hold the Line is a white event deck focusing on Humans .
The rares in this deck are Champion of the Parish , Elite Inquisitor , Mirran Crusader , Mirran Crusader , Honor of the Pure , Honor of the Pure , and Nevermore .
